# Source prompt

Create a premium wide editorial photograph for a modern Korean B2B corporate website. A small diverse Korean project team of four professionals gathers around a refined architectural material prototype and large worktable in a contemporary studio. The scene should feel applicable to technology, design, construction, professional services, and product companies rather than one specific industry. Calm confidence, authentic collaboration, subtle cobalt-blue detail, warm natural materials, restrained charcoal and stone palette. Compose in 16:9 landscape with generous dark negative space on the left for a Korean headline and the people/action weighted to the right. Realistic documentary photography, natural window light, sophisticated magazine art direction, crisp but not glossy. No visible logos, no text, no watermarks, no futuristic UI, no hard hats, no factory machinery, no stock-photo handshake pose.
